Name: Arcade Extras (7 Mini-Games)
Author: iamBLAZEfr
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Arcade Extras turns the Prairie King arcade cabinet into a full multi-game machine. Interact with it and a retro “Arcade Extras” menu opens. From there you can play the original [b]Journey of the Prairie King[/b] and [b]Junimo Kart[/b], or choose from seven brand-new mini-games. It works on the cabinet in the Stardrop Saloon and on the Prairie King Arcade System gifted to you by Gus, so you can place it in your farmhouse and play at home. Everything is drawn in code, so there are no extra files to install.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download the mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Put the ArcadeExtras folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Walk up to the left cabinet in the Saloon (Prairie King), or to the Prairie King Arcade System gifted by Gus, and press the action button.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Multi-game menu: Pick between the original games and the new ones. It works with the mouse, keyboard (W/S or arrows, Space/Enter to pick, Esc to close) and controller (D-pad or stick, A to pick, B to close).[/*]
[*]Seven new games:[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*][b]Junimo Smash[/b]: a brick breaker with power-ups, TNT bricks, combos and 10 levels.[/*]
[*][b]Junimo Snake[/b]: eat fruit, dodge rocks and grab Stardrops.[/*]
[*][b]Pumpkin Smashers[/b]: a whack-a-mole where you spare the rotten pumpkins.[/*]
[*][b]Slime Invaders[/b]: defend the Saloon from waves of slimes, with a Joja saucer for bonus points.[/*]
[*][b]Junimo Flap[/b]: flap through the gaps and earn bronze, silver and gold medals.[/*]
[*][b]Crop Catch[/b]: catch falling crops and dodge the rocks.[/*]
[*][b]Junimo Says[/b]: a memory game where you repeat the pattern.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Saved high scores: Best scores are stored for every game, shared across all your saves.[/*]
[*]Works with the machine from Gus: The Prairie King Arcade System he gifts you opens the same menu anywhere you place it.[/*]
[*]Pause and menus: Every game has a title screen, pause and game over screens. Esc or B takes you back to the arcade menu.[/*]
[*]Settings: A config file is created on first launch, where you can choose which cabinets open the menu.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]No other mods are required.[/*]
[*]Compatibility: Other mods that also take over the Prairie King machine may conflict with this one.[/*]
[/list]
